text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. Instead of just taking a picture, a computer uses complex algorithms to recognize what is in it. For example, image recognition can identify a dog, a tree, or a face in a photo. Another important task is object detection, where the computer not only names objects but also finds their exact location by drawing boxes around them. This technology is used everywhere, from facial recognition on your phone to sorting photos on social media. However, one of its most exciting applications is in self-driving cars, where it helps vehicles detect pedestrians, traffic signs, and other cars instantly to make safe driving decisions.
